name: nanoHUB
description: Purdue-led NSF platform with 500+ free in-browser nanoelectronics and device simulation tools plus lectures and courses (free account required).

name: ABACUS – Assembly of Basic Applications for Coordinated Understanding of Semiconductors (nanoHUB)
description: Free nanoHUB toolkit bundling simulators for crystal structures, band diagrams, PN junctions, BJTs and MOSFETs aimed at device-physics teaching.

name: MOSFET Lab (nanoHUB)
description: Free online 2D drift-diffusion MOSFET simulator on nanoHUB for exploring I-V curves, short-channel effects and doping profiles.

name: PVEducation
description: Free online textbook by Honsberg and Bowden covering semiconductor and solar-cell physics with interactive calculators.

name: PV Lighthouse
description: Free (registration) web calculators such as refractive-index library, OPAL 2 and Wafer Ray Tracer for solar-cell optics and semiconductor modelling; closed source.

name: DEVSIM
description: Open-source TCAD semiconductor device simulator (Apache-2.0) with a Python interface for drift-diffusion and custom PDE device models.

name: Solcore
description: Open-source Python library for modelling solar cells and semiconductor materials, from band structure and optics to full device IV.

name: DoITPoMS – Introduction to Semiconductors (Cambridge)
description: Free Cambridge University teaching package (CC BY-NC-SA) on energy bands, carriers, p-n junctions, BJTs and MOSFETs.

name: MIT 6.012 Microelectronic Devices and Circuits
description: Free MIT OpenCourseWare course with lecture notes and problem sets on semiconductor physics, diodes, BJTs, MOSFETs and amplifiers.

name: MEEP (MIT Electromagnetic Equation Propagation)
description: Open-source FDTD electromagnetics simulator (GPL) widely used for photonic crystals, waveguides and nanophotonics.

name: gdsfactory
description: Open-source Python library for designing photonic, analog and MEMS chips with layout, simulation interfaces and verification.

name: RP Photonics Encyclopedia
description: Free online encyclopedia of laser, fibre optic and photonics topics with thousands of articles by Dr. Rüdiger Paschotta.

name: awesome_photonics
description: Curated GitHub list of open-source photonics simulation, layout and design tools and learning resources.

name: MIT 6.974 Fundamentals of Photonics: Quantum Electronics
description: Free MIT OCW course on lasers, optical resonators, amplification and light-matter interaction.

name: SparkFun Sensor Tutorials
description: Free open-licensed (CC BY-SA) tutorials and hookup guides for accelerometers, gas, distance, temperature and other sensors.

name: Adafruit Unified Sensor Driver
description: Open-source Arduino abstraction layer giving a common API and SI units across dozens of Adafruit sensor drivers.

name: MIT 6.777J Design and Fabrication of MEMS
description: Free MIT OCW course on MEMS fabrication, mechanical modelling, sensing and actuation design.

name: MIT 2.737 Mechatronics
description: Free MIT OCW graduate course with labs on electronics interfacing, power amplifiers, sensing, transducers and control of mechatronic systems.

name: ElectroSmash
description: Free in-depth circuit analyses of classic guitar pedals and amps (Fuzz Face, Tube Screamer, ProCo RAT) plus open pedal projects.

name: Mutable Instruments Eurorack (source)
description: Open-source hardware schematics and firmware (MIT/CC-BY-SA) for Mutable Instruments modules like Braids, Clouds, Plaits and Rings.

name: Mutable Instruments Documentation
description: Archived manuals and technical documentation for all Mutable Instruments synthesizer modules.

name: Music From Outer Space (Ray Wilson)
description: Ray Wilson's site with free DIY synthesizer schematics, the Weird Sound Generator and analog synth project write-ups.

name: YuSynth
description: Free schematics and build documentation for dozens of DIY analog modular synthesizer modules by Yves Usson.

name: Elliott Sound Products
description: Rod Elliott's long-running free library of audio amplifier, preamp, power supply and filter design articles and projects.

name: DaisySP
description: Open-source (MIT) C++ DSP library of oscillators, filters and effects for embedded audio on the Daisy platform and beyond.

name: VCV Rack
description: Open-source (GPLv3) virtual Eurorack modular synthesizer for learning patching and synth signal flow.

name: Moritz Klein (YouTube)
description: Free YouTube series teaching analog synth design from first principles—VCOs, VCFs, mixers—on breadboards.

name: SavvyCAN
description: Open-source Qt tool for capturing, reverse-engineering and visualising CAN bus traffic with DBC support and many adapters.

name: cantools
description: Python package to parse DBC/KCD files, encode/decode CAN messages and monitor buses.

name: python-can
description: Python CAN library supporting SocketCAN, PCAN, Vector, Kvaser and many other interfaces for sending and logging frames.

name: opendbc (comma.ai)
description: Community open-source database of DBC files decoding CAN messages for hundreds of car models.

name: openpilot (comma.ai)
description: Open-source driver-assistance system providing adaptive cruise and lane centering for 300+ supported cars.

name: can-utils (SocketCAN)
description: Official Linux SocketCAN userspace utilities (candump, cansend, cangen) for working with CAN on Linux.

name: awesome-canbus
description: Curated list of open-source CAN bus hardware, software, DBC tools and learning resources.

name: Speeduino
description: Open-source Arduino-based engine management system (ECU) with hardware designs and firmware.

name: The Car Hacker's Handbook (Open Garages)
description: Free online edition of Craig Smith's book on vehicle networks, CAN reverse engineering and automotive security.

name: OpenBCI Documentation
description: Free docs for OpenBCI's open-source EEG/EMG/ECG biosensing boards, GUI and software SDKs.

name: OpenBCI GUI
description: Open-source Processing app for streaming, visualising and recording EEG, EMG and ECG data from OpenBCI boards.

name: HeartyPatch (ProtoCentral)
description: Open-source hardware and firmware for an ESP32-based wearable single-lead ECG and heart-rate patch.

name: BioAmp EXG Pill (Upside Down Labs)
description: Open-source tiny biopotential amplifier board from India for recording ECG, EMG, EOG and EEG with any MCU.

name: NeuroKit2
description: Open-source Python toolbox for ECG, PPG, EDA, EMG and EEG signal processing and analysis.

name: PhysioNet
description: Free MIT-hosted repository of physiological signal databases (e.g., MIT-BIH arrhythmia) and open-source analysis software.

name: TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers (LiteRT Micro)
description: Google's open-source (Apache-2.0) inference runtime for running ML models on microcontrollers with kilobytes of RAM.

name: HarvardX TinyML Courseware
description: Open-source slides, Colab notebooks and Arduino labs from Harvard's TinyML course series, freely reusable.

name: Harvard TinyML (Tiny Machine Learning Open Education)
description: Harvard's TinyML education hub linking free course materials, workshops and the TinyML curriculum.

name: emlearn
description: Open-source tool that converts scikit-learn/Keras models into portable C code for microcontrollers.

name: OpenMV
description: Open-source MicroPython machine-vision camera firmware and hardware for running vision and TinyML on MCUs.

name: iFixit Repair Guides
description: Free community repair manuals (CC BY-NC-SA) with step-by-step teardown, soldering and replacement guides for thousands of devices.

name: Adafruit Guide to Excellent Soldering
description: Free illustrated tutorial covering tools, technique, common problems and desoldering.

name: Soldering Is Easy (comic)
description: Free CC-licensed comic book by Mitch Altman, Andie Nordgren and Jeff Keyzer teaching through-hole soldering.

name: Louis Rossmann (YouTube)
description: Free board-level laptop/MacBook repair videos and right-to-repair advocacy by Louis Rossmann.

name: Northridge Fix (YouTube)
description: Free microsoldering and console/phone board repair videos showing real diagnostics on the bench.

name: Virtual Labs (vlab.co.in) – Electronics & Communications
description: Free Ministry of Education/IIT virtual labs for analog, digital, VLSI, DSP and semiconductor physics experiments online.

name: NPTEL (YouTube)
description: Official NPTEL channel with thousands of free full-length IIT/IISc lecture courses across ECE subjects.

name: GATE Overflow for GATE ECE
description: Free community Q&A with previous-year GATE ECE questions, solutions and subject-wise practice.

name: eSim (FOSSEE, IIT Bombay)
description: Open-source EDA suite from IIT Bombay combining KiCad, Ngspice and GHDL for schematic, simulation and PCB design.

name: SWAYAM
description: Government of India's free MOOC platform hosting NPTEL and university electronics courses (certification exams optional and paid).

name: The Embedded New Testament
description: Comprehensive open GitHub knowledge base for embedded systems interview recap: C, RTOS, protocols, hardware and Linux.

name: TheEmbeDEADInterview
description: GitHub collection of embedded C, microcontroller and OS interview questions with answers.

name: VLSI Interview Questions
description: Repository of digital design and Verilog interview problems for VLSI roles.

name: Revolution – Computer History Museum online exhibit
description: Free online exhibit tracing 2,000 years of computing including transistors, integrated circuits and memory.

name: World Radio History
description: Free archive of scanned electronics magazines (Popular Electronics, Radio-Electronics, Elektor, Wireless World) and radio history.

name: CuriousMarc (YouTube)
description: Free videos restoring historic electronics like the Apollo Guidance Computer and vintage test gear.

name: Asianometry (YouTube)
description: Free deep-dive videos on semiconductor industry history, fabs, lithography and chip technology.

name: Exploratorium Science Snacks
description: Free CC BY-NC-SA hands-on activities from San Francisco's Exploratorium, including electricity, magnetism and light experiments.
